kind: Implementation gaps from inspected current contracts, not new goal requirements or absent-paper claims

gaps.current_status: 169 has an absolute measured_spread input and a derived SD/M CV; no dedicated reported within-run/between-run CV fields or selected-reader path.
gaps.why_distinct: A reported relative CV must not enter the absolute SD input. Missing input to169 does not establish that a paper omits CV.
gaps.workload173: Keep role-correct partial returns; do not silently relabel reported CV as SD. Additional reader remains unfinished.

gaps.component: Linear reporter calibration fit and sample/blank conversion
gaps.current_status: 169 computes a recovery pair; it does not read slope/intercept, fit uncertainty or transform sample/blank responses through a linear calibration. Existing optical calculator is a different NADH extinction model.
gaps.why_distinct: An applicable slope and same-calibration blank differ from residual recovery; avoid double correction and double intercept subtraction.
gaps.workload173: No silent expansion of current recovery op; remain explicit separate unfinished conversion.
